allow: PowerShell($deadline=\(Get-Date\).AddSeconds\(90\); do { try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest http://127.0.0.1:8080/health -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 2; break } catch { Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 700 } } while \(\(Get-Date\) -lt $deadline\); "health: $\($r.StatusCode\) $\($r.Content\)"; $body = [Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes\('{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Chào bạn, nói một câu ngắn."}],"max_tokens":40}'\); $x = Invoke-RestMethod http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1/chat/completions -Method Post -ContentType 'application/json; charset=utf-8' -Body $body; "ok, tokens: $\($x.usage.completion_tokens\), think_tag: $\($x.choices[0].message.content -match '<think>'\)"; \(Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8080 -State Listen\).LocalAddress)

PowerShell($deadline=\(Get-Date\).AddSeconds\(60\); $ok=$false; do { try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest http://127.0.0.1:8765/health -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 2; $ok=$true } catch { Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 700 } } until \($ok -or \(Get-Date\) -gt $deadline\); if \(-not $ok\) { 'server chua len'; return }; "health: $\($r.StatusCode\)"; $body = [Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes\('{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Chào bạn, nói một câu ngắn."}],"max_tokens":60}'\); $x = Invoke-RestMethod http://127.0.0.1:8765/v1/chat/completions -Method Post -ContentType 'application/json; charset=utf-8' -Body $body -TimeoutSec 60; "tokens: $\($x.usage.completion_tokens\) | co <think>: $\($x.choices[0].message.content -match '<think>'\) | reasoning: $\([bool]$x.choices[0].message.reasoning_content\)"; \(Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8765 -State Listen\).LocalAddress)
